title: OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29327v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. translated_title: OACap：面向详细视频描述的描述引导式主动观察
translated_abstract: 与问答任务不同（问答中的查询已明确了感知目标），开放式详细视频描述必须自主决定需要获取什么证据，以及如何将这些证据整合成连贯的全局描述。我们提出了观察自适应视频描述器，这是一个以描述为中心的智能体，它将描述中缺乏支持或缺失的信息转化为有针对性的观察请求，利用时空工具获取证据，并迭代地验证和修订描述内容。在使用固定的纯文本阅读器的情况下，OACap 生成的描述在多个通用视频理解基准上均取得了一致的性能提升。为了更好地诊断这些描述所保留的信息，我们引入了事实-语义描述基准（FSCap-Bench）。其中的核心支撑事实性得分（CSFS）将断言精确度与重要性感知的事实覆盖率相结合，在 93.0-98.3% 的有效描述对上对四种受控扰动类型做出了符合预期的响应。其跨模态语义往返得分（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了以描述为中心的智能体框架 OACap，它能将视频描述中缺失或缺乏支持的信息转化为主动观察请求，借助时空工具获取证据并迭代验证修订描述，从而显著提升详细视频描述质量，同时引入 FSCap-Bench 基准及 CSFS 等评分指标来系统评估描述的事实性与语义保真度。
en_tdlr: OACap is a caption-centered agent that converts unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, acquires evidence through spatiotemporal tools, and iteratively verifies and refines captions to improve detailed video captioning, accompanied by FSCap-Bench with metrics like CSFS for evaluating factual-semantic captioning quality.
